'''Andy McKillip''' (also published as '''Andy McCillip''')<ref name="dt-12225">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12225 BIE/B/Inhanced BIBeatdownBIB], DeckTech (Andy "s_0_s" McKIllip, 10 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12225/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12225/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018085634/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12225/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''s_0_s''') posted a [[Light]] [[Echo Base Operations]] list on DeckTech in December 2000. Andy McKillip also finished 5th at [[June 2000 Terre Haute tournament]] on 24 June 2000 with Cloud City deck, according to Matthew Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d935">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ terre-haute-in-6-24-00], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-terre-haute-in-6-24-00d935/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
